details.description: Ezee Garbage Bags help maintain cleanliness and hygiene at home, in the office, and in your surroundings. They are ideal for disposing of messy waste such as baby diapers and kitty litter. Suitable for offices and hotels, they are also useful for disposing of leftover party plates and other waste. Each bag comes with a detachable tie tape that allows you to securely tie the bag, making it easier to carry and dispose of after use. These small-sized garbage bags fit most small dustbins.

Ezee Printed Bake & Wrap Paper is a versatile, food grade paper designed for everyday kitchen use. Ideal for wrapping breads, chapatis, parathas, sandwiches, and snacks, it helps keep food fresh and hygienic. The non stick and grease resistant surface ensures easy handling without tearing or sticking. Suitable for baking and reheating, it is safe for use in ovens and microwaves. The printed design adds a clean and appealing touch to food presentation. Convenient and easy to use, this 25 m roll is perfect for homes, tiffins, and quick meal preparation, making daily food wrapping simple and efficient for modern kitchens.

Introducing Ezee Air Fryer Paper, designed to make air frying cleaner, faster, and more convenient. This pack includes 100 disposable air fryer paper sheets that help protect your air fryer basket from oil stains, food residue, and burnt crumbs, reducing the need for frequent scrubbing and deep cleaning. Made from high-quality food-grade parchment paper, these disposable liners are heat-resistant, oil-proof, and non-stick. They can withstand high cooking temperatures in air fryers, ovens, OTGs, and microwaves without tearing or burning easily. The thick paper construction provides added durability, making it suitable for lifting heavy or oily foods such as fries, nuggets, chicken wings, paneer tikka, samosas, and cutlets. The 8-inch or 20.32 cm square design fits most standard air fryer baskets, providing full bottom coverage while allowing proper air circulation for even cooking. The flat sheet design makes it easy to place the liner inside the basket and add food directly on top. Its oil-proof surface prevents grease from seeping through, helping keep your appliance clean and extending its lifespan. These multipurpose air fryer paper sheets can also be used for baking trays, steaming, serving snacks, or lining microwave plates. Ideal for everyday cooking and party snacks, they help save time while ensuring clean and hygienic food preparation.
